criterion: A data management plan exists and is accessible
Data source and reuse conditions were assessed and recorded before use
Data are stored in an open non-proprietary format
A README or data dictionary documents each variable
Data carry an explicit open license
Data are deposited in a repository with a persistent identifier
Existing code or tools were assessed before reuse and the choice is documented
Code has an explicit open-source license
Instructions allow a third party to reproduce the reported outputs
A specific citable release of the code is archived with an identifier
Contributions and authorship roles are stated
Prior open results relied on are cited
The paper is openly accessible under an open license
Methods are described in enough detail to repeat the work
